title: Masterpieces by Pinoy artists on display at PICC in time for ASEAN Summit
summary: Over 60 masterpieces by Filipino artists are currently on display at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City as global leaders gather there for the 49th ASEAN Summit.
